name: Slamming Gate AP OLD
description: The heavy gate slams shut when opened more than halfway
disable: DC 15 Thievery (trained) to loosen the gate's springs before it slams closed
reset: The trap can be reactivated (or deactivated, if it's active) by flipping a lever hidden in the nearby wall. A character Searching the area finds it with a successful DC 18 Perception check.

generalAbilities.name: Slam Shut
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The door is opened more than halfway

Effect The door slams shut and deals 3d8 Bludgeoning Damage damage to any creature in the way (Basic DC 17 Reflex Saving Throw). On a critical failure, the creature is also Restrained by the closed door until it Escapes
